api_docstrings.mj_step:
mj_step(m: mujoco._structs.MjModel, d: mujoco._structs.MjData, nstep: typing.SupportsInt = 1) -> None

Advance simulation, use control callback to obtain external force and control. Optionally, repeat nstep times.

semantics: contact.efc_address indexes the constraint array for a contact; it is not a contact-array index.
mj_contactForce returns a six-dimensional force/torque in the contact frame for an existing contact id.
efc_type/efc_id/efc_force/efc_pos/efc_vel are constraint-space arrays ordered by active constraint rows, not by raw contact rows.
mj_forward computes forward dynamics without integrating time; this audit did not call it.
post-step mj_forward values in historical traces are recomputed derived quantities and are not historical integration impulses.
